semanticDiffSummary: After the AC-001 gate on PR #39 head 176be565 showed that the accepted 'oldest in-window frame' rule captures an intermediate repaint on the first keystroke (GA-007), the user decided (Q-003, DEC-004) that a key-down waits until a frame at least 100 ms after the event is retained or the 250 ms deadline passes and then selects the NEWEST in-window frame; DEC-002's selection clause is superseded, AC-002 and FEATURE.md restate the rule and its tests, PR-01 is superseded by a new slice PR-02 that integrates the PR-01 commit and applies the correction, and DEC-005 records the user's explicit Q-004 decision to stop further Pro sends for this change.
applicabilityRationale: The selection rule the Pro response recommended (oldest eligible in-window frame) is replaced by newest-in-window after a settle, and the slice topology changes (PR-01 superseded, PR-02 added), so the prior response is not applicable to the revised specification and a fresh primary would ordinarily be required; the user explicitly waived that fresh primary (Q-004, DEC-005), so adoption proceeds through the adopt-plan Pro-primary waiver with a fresh CLEAN blind-completeness receipt.
